evidence.detail: in_rotation() returns True unconditionally when always_show_rotation config is set, keeping /rotation visible after rotation ends
When not in_rotation, prefix becomes 'Rotation is ' (not 'in progress') and a note says 'Data from the last rotation is shown', but the messaging is acknowledged as confusing
Issue proposes three options: hide /rotation again, make /rotation/changes primary, or 'something more radical' — no owner decision

triage.notes: The config flag always_show_rotation is already the workaround; the decision needed is whether to restore auto-hiding, redesign the page's messaging, or redirect to /rotation/changes after rotation completes.
